_instructions.overview: Add your own discipline rules, seniority rules, and certifications here. These are merged with the built-in taxonomy on every run — no code changes needed.
_instructions.discipline_rules: Each entry maps a display label to a list of keywords. If ANY keyword appears in the job title (case-insensitive), the discipline matches. More specific rules should come first — they are checked top to bottom and the first match wins. Use the 'Family — Specialty' format for the label so the UI can group by family.
_instructions.seniority_rules: Same format as discipline_rules. Checked after discipline. First match wins.
_instructions.certifications: Each entry maps a certification short name to a list of keywords/patterns. If any pattern appears in the title, the certification is flagged as true. These appear as badges in the UI and are filterable. 'PE' is built-in — add others here.
_instructions.keyword_tip: Keywords are matched as substrings of the normalized title (lowercased, punctuation replaced with spaces). A keyword like 'pmp' will match 'PMP', 'PMP Certified', 'pmp,', etc.
